---
title: One author
subtitle: The role heading is singular here
author:
  - name: Ada Lovelace
    roles:
      - original author
    affiliation:
      - name: Analytical Engine Institute
        position: Head of Research
---

With one author the heading reads `Role`.
With more than one it reads `Roles`.
Both strings come from `role-title-single` and `role-title-plural` in `_quarto.yml`.

The partial picks between them with Pandoc's `rest` pipe: `$if(by-author/rest)$` is true only when the array has more than one entry.
